chain_words.nuance: a small change to make something work better
change to suit a new situation
change the form or character of something
a complete review and rebuilding of a system

explanation: These words all express change, from a small adjustment to a complete rebuilding of a system, which is common when technology changes how work is done.

usage_notes.difference: 'Adjust' is used for small changes to settings or methods; 'adapt' describes changing yourself or a system to fit a new environment.
